parameter_selection: The frozen adaptive-segmentation-1.1.0 algorithm and all 28 official validation triples are evaluated once. No threshold, polarity, morphology, sample, or condition is selected from the results.
warnings: The validation images are mouse intestinal organoids, not the challenge organ-on-chip fields.
Ground truth identifies one annotated organoid structure per image and is not an instance-level cell count.
JPEG masks contain compression values; the official greater-than-0.5 grayscale rule is reproduced.
The 28 images form two conditions but are not asserted to be 28 independent biological replicates.
The external result cannot select a model, alter the frozen OoC protocol, or open the OoC test set.
